This caused new pods (ReplicaSet `app-6b95bcf44c`) to fail with `CreateContainerConfigError: couldn't find key missing-key in Secret default/app-secret`, stalling the rollout at 1/3 replicas updated.

**Fix Applied:**
Updated the deployment configuration to reference the correct secret key `password` instead of `missing-key`:
- Changed `secretKeyRef.key` from `missing-key` to `password` in the deployment spec

**Verification After Fix:**
| Metric | Before | After |

| READY pods | 3/3 (old) / 0/1 (new stuck) | 3/3 |
| UP-TO-DATE replicas | 1/3 | 3/3 |
| AVAILABLE replicas | 3/4 | 3/3 |
| Pod Status | CreateContainerConfigError error | Running 1/1 |
| Rollout Status | Stalled at 1 out of 3 | Successfully rolled out |
